_comment: Cernity NDR — Entity Timeline (Splunk), portable source (rendering to native Simple XML for import is a downstream deploy step — see deploy/siem/README.md, 'Rendering' — not part of this unit). Each input/drilldown names a Splunk CIM field that maps back to a siem_pivot.schema.json field, and each drilldown's `bind` is a field the panel's query actually produces (deploy/siem/test_packs.py enforces both). The aggregate panel drills only on the surviving split field (signature_id); per-occurrence identifiers (finding/observation) come from the non-aggregated occurrences table that retains them. Independently authored (§26): no Corelight dashboards/wording.
title: Cernity NDR — Entity Timeline

panels.title: Findings over time (by signature)
panels.search: `cernity_ndr_findings` risk_object="$entity$" dvc="$sensor$" | timechart count by signature_id

panels.title: Finding occurrences
panels.search: `cernity_ndr_findings` risk_object="$entity$" dvc="$sensor$" | table _time, vendor_finding_id, signature_id, dvc, vendor_observation_id, vendor_pcap_evidence_id
